# UX and Persistence Checklist: Curso-PSWE-07

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of UX/accessibility and persistence/failure-safety requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: UX/accessibility and persistence/failure safety (user selection A).
**Depth**: Standard.
**Audience / Timing**: Feature reviewer; generated before task generation and evaluated before implementation.

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the feature specification and planning artifacts.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines that its requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` records review of the written requirements; it does not indicate implementation completion. All items were generated unchecked; the checked markers below reflect the subsequent user-authorized agent review, not application execution.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are required list/detail content, application identity, and available task actions explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-003/FR-006/FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 Are shared add/edit form requirements complete for required and optional fields, existing values, validation, Save, and Cancel? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-005/FR-008, Spec §US1/US3]
- [x] CHK003 Are all three filters, the active-selection indication, and both empty-collection and empty-result states specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Are warning styling, explicit deletion confirmation, cancellation, and the scope of deletion defined together? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §US4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are "clearly visible", "prominent", and "generous white space" defined sufficiently for consistent review, or explicitly identified as bounded design discretion? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005/FR-006/FR-013]
- [x] CHK006 Are empty and whitespace-only descriptions, the No description fallback, and preservation of description line breaks defined consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Task]
- [x] CHK007 Is "same user environment" precise about the retention boundary and exclusions, without implying continuity across environments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK008 Are the initial completion state and both completion-action labels unambiguous for every task status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002/FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the initial All filter and retained filter on return from detail agree across functional requirements, scenarios, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/FR-011, Spec §US2, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Are edit requirements consistent about preserving task identity, completion status, and creation order while changing only title/description? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §State transitions]
- [x] CHK011 Are completion changes, filtered membership, status labels, and completed-title styling described without conflicting state rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/FR-007/FR-009/FR-011, Spec §US2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Does the 60-second create-and-open criterion define an identifiable starting point, completion point, and walkthrough conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK013 Does the persistence criterion distinguish application/browser closure from a page refresh and identify the retained fields, confirmed deletions, and three reopening cycles? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012/SC-003, Plan §Validation Strategy]
- [x] CHK014 Are supported-browser expectations and the scope of responsive acceptance explicitly aligned between specification and plan, including how claimed browser coverage will be assessed? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Spec §FR-014/SC-005, Plan §Technical Context]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK015 Are alternate-flow requirements complete for omitted descriptions, cancelled creation, cancelled edits, and cancelled deletion? [Coverage, Alternate Flow, Spec §US1/US3/US4]
- [x] CHK016 Are exception requirements distinct for unreadable saved tasks and unsuccessful task mutations, including clear errors and preservation of existing data? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-015, Spec §US5, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are recovery expectations after failed saves or unreadable saved data specified, including retained input and whether retry is available? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-015, Spec §US5]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are long-title and multiline-description requirements explicit about wrapping and action reachability without inventing unrequested content limits? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK019 Are duplicate titles distinguished from task identity, and is the response to a task that no longer exists documented without permitting changes to other tasks? [Coverage, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §Task/State transitions]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements complete for the final matching task being deleted or changing status under an active filter? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010/FR-011, Spec §US2/US4]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK021 Are keyboard access, visible focus, accessible names, focus containment, and focus restoration specified across both screens and all form/confirmation states? [Accessibility, Completeness, Spec §FR-014/SC-006, UI Contract §Shared add/edit form/Delete confirmation]
- [x] CHK022 Are minimum text-contrast requirements unambiguous about normal versus large text and applicable to muted/completed text and warning styling? [Accessibility, Measurability, Spec §FR-009/FR-013/FR-014, UI Contract §Visual and accessible behavior]
- [x] CHK023 Are retention/privacy boundaries and the absence of accounts or cross-device continuity explicit, without suggesting unrequired authentication or backup guarantees? [Scope, Completeness, Spec §FR-012/FR-016, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Do the measurable target-size and viewport requirements explicitly cover list, detail, shared forms, and deletion confirmation? [Accessibility, Coverage, Spec §FR-014/SC-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 Are the persistence assumptions and exclusions in the plan consistent with the specification's retention promise and restricted feature scope? [Assumption, Consistency, Spec §FR-012/FR-016, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK026 Is the distinction between retained task data and temporary screen/filter/unsaved-form state explicit, including what need not survive reopening? [Assumption, Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Completion filter/UI state]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK027 Are added interaction details in the design traceable to the specification or clearly documented as design decisions within its scope? [Traceability, Conflict, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Requirements Traceability, UI Contract]
- [x] CHK028 Are unresolved reviewer findings distinguished from accepted assumptions, with a clear requirement-level resolution before affected implementation begins? [Ambiguity, Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- References use FR/SC identifiers and US1-US5 for the specification's numbered user stories. A Gap or Ambiguity marker identifies a review question, not a concluded defect.
- Sources: [specification](../spec.md), [plan](../plan.md), [UI contract](../contracts/ui.md), and [data model](../data-model.md). No tasks.md exists at generation time.
- Scope includes primary, alternate, exception, recovery, and accessibility requirements. Accounts, synchronization, deployment, and performance tuning remain outside this review's focus.
- Reviewers should record evidence or a finding beside an item before changing its marker. This generation did not evaluate or approve the items and did not alter the specification or plan.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify reviewer-owned markers.
- The existing `requirements.md` checklist has its separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.

## Review Corrections - 2026-10-26

The user explicitly requested agent-assisted evaluation and resolution of the existing items.
This is a requirements review, separate from checklist generation and application implementation.
The following corrections were applied and independently re-reviewed before item markers changed.

| Finding / item | Document correction | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| A1 / CHK005 | Add task availability and title prominence have observable meanings; exact styling is explicitly bounded design discretion. | Spec FR-005/FR-006/FR-013; UI Contract Visual and accessible behavior |
| CHK012 | The timed walkthrough has fixed input, ready-state start, detail/status endpoint, and explicit setup exclusions. | Spec SC-001; Quickstart Responsive and keyboard review |
| CHK017 | Deliberate retry uses existing controls; failed reads prevent writes; corrected access plus reload restores saved data without reset. | Spec FR-015 and US5.5-US5.6; UI/Service error contracts; T017-T018 |
| CHK022 | Large text and normal text are classified explicitly; muted/completed text and warning labels are included. | Spec FR-014; UI Contract Visual and accessible behavior; Quickstart contrast criteria |
| D1 / CHK028 | FR-010 is authoritative for Delete warning styling; FR-013 cross-references it instead of restating the normative rule. | Spec FR-010/FR-013 |

Contrast classification reference: [W3C contrast guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html).
Browser execution evidence remains Pending in quickstart.md; that future work is distinct from
reviewing whether browser requirements and their acceptance gate are well defined.
